SELECT f.id, f.biz_no, f.stage, f.status, f.veh_code, f.alarm_at, f.measure_kind, f.alarm_value, f.alarm_kind, f.site_no, f.notify_required, f.notify_count, f.reply_count, f.reply_wait_hours, f.notify_done_at, f.reply_claim_stage, f.review_opinion, f.close_kind, f.content, f.last_action, f.del_flag, f.create_by, f.create_time, f.update_by, f.update_time, f.remark, e.site_name, COUNT(*) OVER() AS board_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_veh_handle_flow WHERE del_flag = 0 AND (status IS NULL OR status <> 2)) AS board_active_count FROM t_veh_handle_flow f
LEFT JOIN t_veh_ent e ON e.site_no = f.site_no AND e.del_flag = 0
f.del_flag = 0
AND f.biz_no LIKE CONCAT(#{bizNo}, '%')
AND f.veh_code LIKE CONCAT(#{vehCode}, '%')
AND f.alarm_kind LIKE CONCAT(#{alarmKind}, '%')
AND f.status = #{status}
AND f.close_kind = #{closeKind}
ORDER BY f.id DESC
